subject: MSA amendment + portal onboarding: PO field mapping and signature flow
body:
From: Ryan Clark <ryan.clark@medsync.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding + MSA addendum question

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the portal invite earlier this morning. We started the supplier registration in Ariba but hit a snag: our procurement team flagged that MedSync needs an MSA amendment covering data segregation and tokenization of POs prior to final activation. Can Redwood provide a short amendment (we can countersign) or do you need us to accept the standard MSA and then add the portal-specific addendum later?

Also: two quick technical asks from our IT team so we can map fields correctly in Ariba: 1) do you require a specific PO reference prefix? 2) are there any required custom attributes for invoice routing (GL code / tax jurisdiction)?

If easier I can hop on a short call later this week.

Thanks,
Ryan Clark
Procurement Manager, MedSync Inc.
ryan.clark@medsync.com

---

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Clark <ryan.clark@medsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + MSA addendum question

Thanks Ryan — good questions. Short answers up front and next steps below.

- Amendment: Redwood can issue a portal-specific MSA amendment that addresses data segregation and PO tokenization. Legal prefers to produce a 1-2 page amendment rather than reworking the core MSA. Marissa (cc'd) will share a redline.
- PO prefix & attributes: we do not mandate a prefix, but Order ID and PO Line Item ID are required. For invoice routing we recommend sending GL code (custom field GL_CODE) and tax_jurisdiction; we can accept them as optional attributes in Ariba's supplier profile.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will attach a draft amendment/redline for your review (Docx).
2) Karthik will attach a field mapping spreadsheet with the exact attribute names we expect from Ariba.
3) If agreeable, we can provision the vendor record in the portal once MedSync signs the amendment — we can also enable a temporary test PO route for validation.

Would a Thu 10:00am PT call work to walk through the redline and mapping?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Clark <ryan.clark@medsync.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DRAFT - MSA amendment for portal provisioning (redlined)

Ryan — attaching a redline of the amendment that narrowly addresses the portal requirements you mentioned. Highlights: data segregation obligations, customer-controlled tokenization keys for PO references, audit log retention (90 days default, option to extend for enterprise), and a short clause describing that Order Forms will inherit the MSA except where the amendment carves out portal-specific fields.

Key open items for MedSync:
- Tokenization scope: do you need Redwood to manage token keys (we offer a managed-key option) or will MedSync provide keys via your KMS?
- Audit retention SLA: we have a standard 90-day retention for activity traces, pricing available to extend to 365 days.

Attachments: MSA_Amendment_Redline_v1.docx

Please mark up and return; if okay, I can route to Legal for a final after your changes.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts and Procurement, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Clark <ryan.clark@medsync.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: vendor onboarding - field mapping (spreadsheet attached)

Attached is the portal-field-mapping-v3.xlsx with the exact attribute names we write into Ariba/ Coupa integration layers. Quick notes:
- Required: order_id, po_line_id, item_sku
- Recommended for routing: GL_CODE (string), TAX_JURISDICTION (string), BILLING_CONTACT_EMAIL
- Tokenization: if you choose managed-key, we will populate "redwood_token" in the PO payload; if you bring your own KMS we will accept an upstream token value under "external_token_id".

Validation step: once you upload a sample PO over the staging connector we will validate the mapping and confirm the PO acknowledgement flow.

Attachment: portal-field-mapping-v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

---

From: Ryan Clark <ryan.clark@medsync.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@medsync.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + MSA addendum question

Camila / Marissa / Karthik — thanks, team. We reviewed the redline and the mapping spreadsheet internally. A couple items from MedSync:
1) MedSync will bring its own KMS keys (so we prefer external_token_id).
2) We would like audit retention extended to 365 days as a paid option — can you provide a quote for that?
3) We will accept the amendment wording with two small edits (clarify that tokenized POs remain searchable by order_id in the portal UI and a minor clarification to the audit access clause).

We can sign once the two small edits are accepted. Thu 10:00am PT works for a short call to confirm language and to do a staging PO upload together.

Thanks,
Ryan
Procurement Manager, MedSync Inc.
